name: learn-visual-tools
description: Render backends for the mermaid-maker and svg-maker subagents. Replaces the pi visual-tools extension.
comment: puppeteer is a PEER dependency of mermaid-cli and is not auto-installed, so it is declared directly here. puppeteer.config.cjs skips its bundled Chromium download: render-mermaid.mjs points puppeteer at the Chrome already installed on the machine via PUPPETEER_EXECUTABLE_PATH.
